output.summary: Exceptional fit. Eight years of commercial operations, process transformation, and cross-functional program delivery at Google directly match a seven-year commercial ops requirement. Core competencies—workflow redesign, UAT leadership, SQL/Looker reporting, partner coordination, and change management—align precisely with the JD. Domain switch from generic commercial ops to claims/billing is manageable; operational methodology and analytical rigor are portable. Language match (English professional, German native) is a strong bonus. Primary gaps are domain-specific (claims/billing/fintech) and readily mitigable through rapid stakeholder learning.
